---- MODULE alphafold3_spec ----
EXTENDS Integers, Sequences, FiniteSets, Reals, TLC

CONSTANTS 
    MaxSequenceLength,
    MaxAtoms,
    NumDiffusionSteps,
    MaxBatchSize,
    Proteins,
    Atoms,
    Coordinates

VARIABLES
    protein_sequences,
    msa_data,
    template_structures,
    attention_weights,
    diffusion_state,
    predicted_coordinates,
    confidence_scores,
    model_state,
    training_data,
    validation_results,
    system_state

    /\ protein_sequences \in [Proteins -> Seq(STRING)]
    /\ msa_data \in [Proteins -> Seq(Seq(STRING))]
    /\ template_structures \in [Proteins -> Seq(REAL^3)]
    /\ attention_weights \in [Proteins -> [1..MaxSequenceLength -> [1..MaxSequenceLength -> REAL]]]
    /\ diffusion_state \in [Proteins -> [1..NumDiffusionSteps -> [Atoms -> REAL^3]]]
    /\ predicted_coordinates \in [Proteins -> [Atoms -> REAL^3]]
    /\ confidence_scores \in [Proteins -> [Atoms -> REAL]]
    /\ system_state \in {"Initializing", "Processing", "Training", "Predicting", "Complete", "Error"}

Init ==
    /\ protein_sequences = [p \in Proteins |-> <<>>]
    /\ msa_data = [p \in Proteins |-> <<>>]
    /\ template_structures = [p \in Proteins |-> <<>>]
    /\ attention_weights = [p \in Proteins |-> [i \in 1..MaxSequenceLength |-> [j \in 1..MaxSequenceLength |-> 0.0]]]
    /\ diffusion_state = [p \in Proteins |-> [step \in 1..NumDiffusionSteps |-> [a \in Atoms |-> <<0.0, 0.0, 0.0>>]]]
    /\ predicted_coordinates = [p \in Proteins |-> [a \in Atoms |-> <<0.0, 0.0, 0.0>>]]
    /\ confidence_scores = [p \in Proteins |-> [a \in Atoms |-> 0.0]]
    /\ model_state = "Uninitialized"
    /\ training_data = <<>>
    /\ validation_results = <<>>
    /\ system_state = "Initializing"

ProcessMSA(protein) ==
    /\ system_state = "Processing"
    /\ protein \in Proteins
    /\ Len(protein_sequences[protein]) > 0
    /\ msa_data' = [msa_data EXCEPT ![protein] = GenerateMSA(protein_sequences[protein])]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<protein_sequences, template_structures, attention_weights, diffusion_state, predicted_coordinates, confidence_scores, model_state, training_data, validation_results, system_state>>

ComputeAttention(protein) ==
    /\ system_state = "Processing"
    /\ protein \in Proteins
    /\ Len(msa_data[protein]) > 0
    /\ attention_weights' = [attention_weights EXCEPT ![protein] = ComputeAttentionWeights(msa_data[protein])]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<protein_sequences, msa_data, template_structures, diffusion_state, predicted_coordinates, confidence_scores, model_state, training_data, validation_results, system_state>>

DiffusionStep(protein, step) ==
    /\ system_state = "Predicting"
    /\ protein \in Proteins
    /\ step \in 1..NumDiffusionSteps
    /\ step > 1 => diffusion_state[protein][step-1] # [a \in Atoms |-> <<0.0, 0.0, 0.0>>]
    /\ diffusion_state' = [diffusion_state EXCEPT ![protein][step] = ApplyDiffusion(diffusion_state[protein][step-1], attention_weights[protein])]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<protein_sequences, msa_data, template_structures, attention_weights, predicted_coordinates, confidence_scores, model_state, training_data, validation_results, system_state>>

PredictStructure(protein) ==
    /\ system_state = "Predicting"
    /\ protein \in Proteins
    /\ diffusion_state[protein][NumDiffusionSteps] # [a \in Atoms |-> <<0.0, 0.0, 0.0>>]
    /\ predicted_coordinates' = [predicted_coordinates EXCEPT ![protein] = diffusion_state[protein][NumDiffusionSteps]]
    /\ confidence_scores' = [confidence_scores EXCEPT ![protein] = ComputeConfidence(diffusion_state[protein])]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<protein_sequences, msa_data, template_structures, attention_weights, diffusion_state, model_state, training_data, validation_results, system_state>>

SafetyProperty ==
    /\ \A p \in Proteins : 
        /\ Len(protein_sequences[p]) <= MaxSequenceLength
        /\ \A a \in Atoms : 
            /\ confidence_scores[p][a] \in [0.0, 1.0]
            /\ Norm(predicted_coordinates[p][a]) < 1000.0

    /\ system_state = "Processing" ~> system_state = "Complete"
    /\ \A p \in Proteins : 
        Len(protein_sequences[p]) > 0 ~> predicted_coordinates[p] # [a \in Atoms |-> <<0.0, 0.0, 0.0>>]

Next ==

    \/ \E p \in Proteins : ComputeAttention(p)
    \/ \E p \in Proteins, s \in 1..NumDiffusionSteps : DiffusionStep(p, s)
    \/ \E p \in Proteins : PredictStructure(p)
